notes:
• ＋ New offer saves the current offer, clears everything (cards, scans, the CardUploader wait), asks for the customer name and the first game, makes a new folder and goes straight to scanning
• 💾 Save offer at any step (button, Ctrl+S, File → Save offer); saved offers reopen at the step you left them, with every card, game and the scan folder
• Offers save themselves after each Send and each CardUploader file
